description: Trigger the full Single Node OpenShift (SNO) installation from a desired-state YAML document. Reads the state file (source of truth for cluster identity, network plan and OpenShift version), resolves iDRAC/webcache/pull-secret references, then runs the idempotent install pipeline (preflight -> ssh-key -> extract -> prepare-configs -> build-iso -> copy-iso -> iDRAC deploy -> wait-install). Re-running is safe: a node that already carries the requested OpenShift is detected and left untouched. Use dry_run=true for a read-only validation + idempotency plan.
name: sno_install
title: SNO Install

description: Validate a Single Node OpenShift desired-state YAML document against the sno.infra/v1 schema. Read-only: safe to call from CI. Returns the resolved cluster identity, base domain, version and node IP.
name: state_validate
title: Validate Desired State

description: Generate the read-only idempotency plan for a desired-state document: which install stages will run, skip or verify, plus warnings (missing pull secret, existing cluster, etc.). Safe on any machine.
name: state_plan
title: State Idempotency Plan

description: List the OpenShift versions currently supported by the Red Hat version catalog (https://api.openshift.com/products/openshift). Read-only: drives the CI version matrix and lets an agent pick a compliant version.
name: ocp_versions
title: OpenShift Versions

description: Return the newest GA OpenShift version from the Red Hat version catalog, including its quay pullspec. Read-only.
name: ocp_latest
title: Latest OpenShift Version
